images.image_prompt: Ultra-photorealistic live-action photography, vertical 4:5, mobile-thumbnail-readable. A dominant protagonist, one decisive action: an attractive adult Korean Shorthair orange-and-white cheese-tabby cat with a natural, balanced, sturdy build; bright warm cheese-orange short fur with realistic darker orange tabby stripes; large natural upright ears; a broad clean white blaze running from the forehead down between the eyes toward the pink nose; clean white fur around the mouth and muzzle, on the chin, continuing naturally down the entire neck, chest and belly; all four paws and lower feet covered in clean white fur like four neat white boots, with the white fur rising naturally from the toes and clearly visible whenever the paws are shown; a distinctive small congenital orange cheese-tabby fur marking around parts of the mouth area, naturally integrated into the otherwise white muzzle, explicitly a permanent fur pattern and never food, dirt or staining; round amber-brown eyes; pink nose; short dense realistic fur; natural whiskers; slightly rounded cheeks; realistic memorable face. The cat is the fantasy quest champion in an Alien first-contact plateau world, standing in a flooded museum grand hall during an Underwater ruin ascent, using a giant bracing stance and tongue sweeping across the nose to support a leaning landmark beside a red theatrical countdown light. The landmark bends like a spring; the collapsing set becomes a sunrise stage, with warm curtains and clear audience silhouettes revealed behind a skyscraper canyon frame. Strong architecture scale, prop urgency, role, twist, expression, and gesture. Shallow controlled water, padded set, hidden transparent supports, safe VFX. No logos, no readable text, no watermark, no famous artwork, no franchise design, no exact emblem, no cartoon, no illustration, no 3D render, no plastic fur, no duplicate cats or limbs, no human features.
